engine: SQLite STRICT ANY (in-memory native SQLite driver)
case: grouped MAX() result storage classes through typed CSV re-import

The app's typed CSV export/import restores every storage class and exact BLOB bytes into a STRICT ANY destination, verified again with native typeof().
